reasons: Missing-clause finding is well supported: no insurance provision exists anywhere in the Agreement, and Kubient is a hosting/services vendor that stores visitor data and Customer Confidential Information, so the playbook's insurance rule is squarely triggered.

The inserted subsection (j) is appended to the existing General Provisions list with correct sequential lettering and does not alter p0073's original text, so it is the smallest edit that reaches the playbook position.

Coverage lines match the preferred position exactly (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M for Customer Data processing, statutory workers' comp, certificates on request), with the cyber limit sensibly tied to the data-handling activities described in the document.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice and prefix, states the rationale (uncapped indemnity/data obligations unsupported) and offers the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback.
Minor drafting nit only (not disqualifying): confirm 'Term' and 'Law' are defined terms in this Agreement; if not, use lower-case 'term' and 'applicable law'.
